Name: LOAD MODULE
checklistText:
<size=22>LOAD OBC MODULE</size>

SIMPLE OBC MODE:
Rotate the COMPUTER MODE selector while the AUX TAPE is in AUTO to trigger loads. The memory will be overwritten with a new MODULE only when the load completes.

ADVANCED OBC MODE:
Program Modules:
MODULE I: 	PRE-LAUNCH
MODULE II: 	ASCENT
MODULE III:	CATCH-UP / RENDEZVOUS
MODULE IV:	TD PRED / RE-ENTRY

All modules are stored as words (Tape Position Word, TPW) on a tape.
ID		FIRST	LAST
III.		090		130
IV.		133		159
V.		176		207

The different program flows required by the COMPUTER selector must be loaded in memory to function.

The COMPUTER selector must be in PRE LN to allow loading of modules.

To load a module, use CORE 62: WWWMM. The 3-digit First Tape Position Word of the module to load followed by a 2-digit mode.
MODE 01: REPROGRAM
MODE 02: VERIFY
MODE 03: REPROGRAM & VERIFY

To load MODULE III:
62|09001 ENTER

To load MODULE IV:
62|13301 ENTER

PROCEDURE:
1.  AC POWER SW			- IGS
2.  COMPUTER MODE		- PRE-LN
3.  COMPUTER POWER		- ON
A.  MDU P0WER			- ON
5.  ATM POWER SWITCH	- OFF
6.  ATM MODE SWITCH		- STBY
7.  Insert desired ATM command via MDU address 62, First Tape Position Word and then Operation Code.
8.  ATM Power Switch	- ON
9.  ATM Mode Switch		- AUTO
10. MONITOR IVI's and TAPE LIGHT
ll. At end of commanded function, the L/R IVI will read one less than the TPW after EOP value, and the tape light will go out.
12. ATM Mode Switch		- STBY
13. ATM Power Switch	- OFF
14. Select desired computer mode
